Development command dispatcher with config parsing, permission checks, and sudo rerun.

# Purpose
This file implements the main command dispatch path for the `fddev` development tool. The [`fd_dev_main`](<#fd_dev_main>) function parses command-line options, selects an `action_t` entry from `ACTIONS`, initializes logging and configuration with `fd_main_init`, and then runs the selected command. It also handles special commands such as `--help` and `--version`, rejects unknown subcommands, and blocks use against a live cluster unless the action allows it.

The file also contains privilege handling for commands that need elevated access. The [`execve_as_root`](<#execve_as_root>) function rebuilds the current process command line and re-executes it through `/usr/bin/sudo`, while preserving selected environment variables and forcing the same log path. Before running an action, [`fd_dev_main`](<#fd_dev_main>) checks required capabilities with `fd_cap_chk`; if permissions are missing, it either reports an error or reruns the command as root. The file therefore acts as the central entry point for `fddev` command execution, configuration setup, and permission control.
